title: Common Real Secants to Pairs of Real Twisted Cubic Curves
summary: It is well established that a general pair of twisted cubic curves in complex projective space has ten common secant lines. As an initial investigation, we show that the monodromy group of the ten common secant lines over the complex numbers is the full symmetric group demonstrating that the common secant lines have no special structure over the complex numbers. We then investigate a novel question in real algebraic geometry: describe the possible collections of ten common secant lines to a pair of real projective twisted cubic curves.
